name: fr.amacunia/npdes-permit-expiration-renewal-application-deadline
title: NPDES Permit Renewal Sentinel
description: When is the renewal application of a US water discharge (NPDES) permit due, and does that date bind?

tools.name: npdes_permit_example
tools.description: Free sample: a real answer, same shape as npdes_permit_lookup.

tools.name: npdes_permit_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need the renewal deadline of a US water discharge permit: for 1 to 10 NPDES permit numbers, the expiration date on file with EPA, the last day to send the renewal application (180 days before expiration, and the safe date one day earlier), whether that date binds (EPA-issued permit) or the State's own rule governs, days left, and the published status once the term has ended. Individual permits only. No facility names, no addresses. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

permits.description: 1 to 10 NPDES permit numbers (9 ASCII letters or digits each, for example NH0100013), comma-separated

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.
